name: I Love My Mom
source:
Help a cute bunny girl survive her Mom's funeral! 
Play a light battle system, timed choices, and a memory game to help her.  

A psychological horror game that explores the aftermath of abuse, while also being a meta commentary on the relationship between a player and a game. The worst is already over, and you need to learn how to keep going even when everything feels hopeless.

[From [url=https://ikarusangel.itch.io/ilovemymom]itch.io[/url]]
